description:
Record money received against threads; records live under payments/<Kind>/<Thread>.md as JSON in an adulting-payments fence.

Subcommands:
  log THREAD AMOUNT [-c ISO] [-d DATE] [-t TIME] [-a ACCOUNT] [-n NOTE] — record a receipt; with no THREAD it runs an INTERACTIVE capture
  list [THREAD] [--since D] [--until D] [--json] — list payments
  statement [--thread T] [--since D] [--until D] [--as-of D] [--pdf PATH] [--json] — billed vs received, by thread and currency
  show ID [--json] — show one payment
  edit ID [--amount A] [-c ISO] [-d DATE] [-t TIME] [-a ACCOUNT] [-n NOTE] — change fields of a payment
  rm ID [-y] — delete a payment

Flags:
  log: -c 3-letter ISO currency, defaults to the thread's; -d date received YYYY-MM-DD, default today; -t HH:MM, default now; -a account the money landed in; -n free-text note; --all only affects interactive mode.
  list: --since / --until YYYY-MM-DD; --json.
  statement: --thread THREAD; --since / --until YYYY-MM-DD; --as-of YYYY-MM-DD statement date, drives aging, default today; --pdf PATH renders a PDF to that path and requires --thread; --json.
  edit: --amount plus the same value flags as log.
  rm: -y skip confirmation.

THREAD is a thread name, 'Kind/Name', or a wikilink. ID is the 8-hex payment id. Amounts must be positive; refunds are not negative payments.

Examples:
  ["log", "Projects/SGB", "15000", "-c", "ZAR", "-d", "2026-06-01", "-a", "Business current"]
  ["list", "Projects/SGB", "--since", "2026-01-01", "--json"]
  ["statement", "--thread", "Projects/SGB", "--as-of", "2026-06-30", "--json"]
  ["rm", "a1b2c3d4", "-y"]

Notes:
  `log` with no THREAD is interactive and reads from stdin — never call it that way; always pass THREAD and AMOUNT.
  `--pdf` without `--thread` is rejected; rendering a statement needs client_name on the thread file.
  `rm` is destructive and prompts unless -y.
  Payment ids share one namespace with `hours` entry ids.
